relations.justification: The scientific method and the treatment of measurement uncertainty are two halves of what makes an experimental claim checkable.
The historical record of paradigm change refutes a purely cumulative account of confirmation, which is why falsification and paradigm accounts remain in tension.
Replication requires a protocol detailed enough for an independent party to repeat the work; an unreproducible method makes the claim unfalsifiable in practice.
Morphological analysis segments forms whose boundaries phonology establishes.
Syntax combines words whose internal structure morphology describes.
Compositional semantics is defined over syntactic structure; the meaning of a complex expression is computed on its parse.
Regular sound change is the mechanism by which a speech community's varieties become distinct languages.
Sociolinguistic variation is social stratification observed in language.
Formalist and structuralist criticism borrow their analytic apparatus directly from linguistics.
Formalism locates meaning in the text and reader-response locates it in the reading; the two cannot both be the whole account.
The Western genre system — epic, tragedy, comedy, lyric — was codified in classical literature and inherited from it.
